scope: Physical melee weapon production, transport, equip/swap/drop/prohibition and v13 save validation in the true multilayer colony. Controlled boundary tests and one normal seed are separately labeled; native evidence is independent.

weaponTests.title: migrates genuine published v12 bytes without adding gear or changing needs
places a free walkable crafting spot and produces a physical no-quality club only after delivering 40 wood
rejects unsupported spots and longswords at a crafting spot
retains progress and delivered steel through reload and returns materials when paused
refuels an empty smithy while a production bill is queued and burns fuel only during actual work
releases a completed blocked output after fuel is exhausted without repeating work or consuming inputs twice
keeps weapon while downed in own bed, but ordinary death drops and forbids it
rejects forged bench recipes, incompatible smith jobs and cross-category duplicate instance identities
keeps forbidden ground weapons out of automatic hauling, but explicit equip clears the flag and reserves one identity
reuses the just-vacated pickup tile for the old weapon even when every other ground cell is full
keeps a drafted equip order through hunger and exhaustion checks and reloads while fetching
rejects player equipment orders for an enemy instead of producing an unloadable weapon task
cancels equipped-fetch on actual dual-arm loss without requiring death or downing and preserves saveable weapon identities
cancels equipped-work on actual dual-arm loss without requiring death or downing and preserves saveable weapon identities
cancels dropping on actual dual-arm loss without requiring death or downing and preserves saveable weapon identities
cancels unarmed-fetch on actual dual-arm loss without requiring death or downing and preserves saveable weapon identities
rejects a saved equip task whose valid injuries already remove all manipulation
rejects a saved drop task whose valid injuries already remove all manipulation
retains an equipped old weapon and carried replacement when no cell is free, through save/load and interruption
failed pre-equip unloading is atomic and does not clear prohibition or partially merge cargo
persists the half-second voluntary drop and marks the resulting physical object forbidden
keeps a casualty weapon pending on full ground, then drops exactly once after one cell becomes free
honors a newly applied prohibition while an automatic hauler is still approaching
hauls one nonmergeable weapon up a ladder and preserves quality and HP across cargo save/load
rejects duplicate equipped/cargo identities, contradictory pending drops and misplaced prohibition fields
keeps three materially distinct recipes, bench speed and original longsword requirements
preserves identity and material HP; club has no rolled quality, weapons have no wear clock
applies wood blunt material power and preserves the Poke source damage definition
uses weapon-specific quality factors and derives AP before hit damage randomization
normalizes the healthy bare-handed Best group to two equal fists, not a 7% bite chance
selects club head as Best and shares Mid across its handle and both natural fists
reconstructs normal knife distribution including the two natural fists
shares longsword Best across stab and slash, and quality can remove fists from Mid
recomputes the bounded candidate groups for injured or missing natural tools
keeps body group damage, global attack factors and weapon eligibility separate
labels seven-region injury mapping explicitly and preserves permanent limb disability
uses caller-supplied sampling deterministically across JSON persistence and boundaries
strictly rejects malformed persisted items, invented club quality and invalid numerical inputs

campaign.scope: Fresh generator-2 colony, normal command/step/save/load and read-only terrain queries. No injected resources, terrain, health, positions, work progress or time. Actual woodcutting, underground mining, elevated smithy, physical weapons and equipment transactions.

limitations: Three fixed-material melee weapons only; no ranged weapons, full armor or complete original damage workers.
Research and skills are pre-unlocked; crafted steel weapons use normal quality; wooden club has no quality component.
Work-in-progress uses a job container and cancels with full refund, unlike native unfinished entities and 75 percent refund.
No environmental deterioration, automated re-equip memory or original room/outdoor/light speed modifiers.
Fuel preserves native per-recipe base usage at 20 TPS; project days are compressed, so 48 per project day rather than native 80.
One normal campaign seed is not balance or long-term population validation. Browser verification uses read-only debug projections/snapshots and actual controls, not screen-only inference.
